name: @thelabcorner/phasor
author: Jackson Cummings
description: Proof-oriented compiler from Web Animations API to standalone animated SVG

scripts.test:chromium: npm run build && node tools/chromium-differential.mjs && node tools/chromium-seeded-differential-v2.mjs
scripts.test:capture: npm run build && node tools/chromium-native-capture.mjs && node tools/chromium-native-transform-capture.mjs && node tools/chromium-capture-refusals.mjs
scripts.test:directions: npm run build && node tools/chromium-direction-differential.mjs && node tools/chromium-negative-delay-differential.mjs
scripts.test:tesseract: npm run build && node tools/tesseract-pareto.mjs && node tools/chromium-tesseract-image.mjs
